preconditions.description: The first line of input must be a lowercase name with at most 10 characters.
The second line of input must be an integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 100.
Each of the n action lines must contain exactly 5 words.

postconditions.description: The output must contain all distinct names sorted by priority factor in descending order, with alphabetical order for ties.

postconditions.expression: all(name in names for name in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: All names in the output must be present in the input actions.
The number of output lines must equal the number of distinct names in the input.
